name: 分割した担当枠
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
One Japanese Lighthouse component LH11-0003 分割した担当枠. Image 1 is the ORIGINAL Deputy source; original geometry, fine controls, proportions, alignment and spacing take priority over rough mock substitutes. Its Thursday Support lane has two vertically stacked split shift cards: upper solid-purple selected shift and lower lightly outlined OPEN shift with bottom-right status badge. Reproduce that distinct state anatomy. Image 2 is our SECONDARY localized Japanese content/layout guide. Image 3 is the approved bus design for white surfaces and forest-green gradients only.
Create a compact single-column split shift component, approximately logical 390x215 at high resolution. Pure white canvas and one quietly rounded white surface, subtle neutral outline and soft shadow, no large extra wrapper. Small date above: 「10月22日（木）」. Upper shift: bold 「10:00–11:30」, regular 「山田 太郎」, quiet 「前半の担当」. Lower shift: bold 「11:30–13:00」, regular 「募集中」, quiet 「後半の担当」, and a small bottom-right outlined status badge 「募集中」, following ORIGINAL badge placement rather than the mock's bottom-left. Keep exactly these data and two slots. Do not add people or extra controls.
State/accent decision: original purple selected state becomes forest-green gradient #174C36 → #1F6444 → #2D8F5E on upper slot with legible white type. Original pink/open outline becomes coherent forest-green outline and white label badge on lower WHITE slot; text says 募集中 so state is not color-only. No broad mint fill from the mock. No decorative colored icons, no unrelated category dots. The source crop has no required utility icons, so do not add any.
Meiryo typography, zero tracking; logical body14/24 regular, metadata12/16, only times bold, preserve Japanese wrapping and modest hierarchy. Original compact corner proportions and split-cell spacing guide fine details, official white/forest/slate rules override source palette. Quiet depth and a gentle edge light on selected gradient; no neon, glossy plastic, ambient tint, English chrome, popup, schedule background or metrics. Static raster candidate, not working UI.
reviewNotes: 原画優先の選択/募集の二状態、日時と文言、右下募集バッジ、森林緑/白の面を保持。下段の募集中の本文が既存Meiryo Regularより太く生成されており書体の太さを要修正。所有者承認・編集・実装なし。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
